full_details: Brooke came down off the shelf for the first time since March. The Verona page was open at the Lent blank, alike in, and you left the gap. Gib slept on the Golding through all of it. On a clean sheet you began in the street, two serving-men of one house. By half past ten you had ninety lines, no blots, and the room was hot. In March the poem wanted heat. It has it. You did not write the Prince's sentence out in the frame. You said the order of it to yourself: they jest first, then somebody is out. An old comedy played at two. You were not in it. At the reckoning the share was ten shillings. You wrote received, and you did not write a new total. The roads were left for Monday. You came home by Bishopsgate Street.
one_sentence: You took Brooke down at first light, wrote the brawl as far as the Prince, and at the reckoning took ten shillings.
title: Ninety lines of a brawl, and ten shillings
